Add Scope 1/2/3 emission extraction improvement (NER model for emission quantities). Add net-zero commitment timeline extraction. Add climate transition risk vs physical risk classification. Target: adversarial 9.

Add mempool monitoring via Infura free tier (detect large pending transactions). Add smart contract event log parsing (ERC-20 Transfer events). Add bridge flow monitoring (cross-chain capital movement). Add whale wallet labeling (map known exchange/institutional wallets via Etherscan labels). Add event severity scoring with push notification. Target: adversarial 9.

Add impermanent loss calculator for LP positions. Add Uniswap v3 concentrated liquidity analytics (active range % of pool). Add price impact calculator (for size X, what is slippage on DEX vs CEX). Add DEX arbitrage opportunity scanner (price discrepancy between Uniswap/Curve/Balancer). Add liquidity depth heatmap. Target: adversarial 9.

Add Polygon Starter ($30/mo) WebSocket real-time SIP feed. Add quote consolidation (NBBO from multiple venues). Add real-time trade ticker. Add Level 1 streaming to terminal display. Add WebSocket reconnect with message replay. NOTE: This is the single highest-ROI paid upgrade ($30/mo → 6 point improvement on dim 1, +real-time for dims 3, 11). Target: adversarial 9.

Add Polygon historical 1-min bars (2 years free tier, 20+ years Starter). Add intraday VWAP calculation. Add intraday momentum signals (opening range breakout, VWAP cross). Add intraday volatility regime detection. Add session-based statistics (overnight vs RTH return decomposition). Requires Polygon Starter. Target: adversarial 9.

waves.label: Score-3→2 TradingView, Pre/Post-Market, N-PORT & VC/PE
waves.rationale: TradingView charting is a massive UX win (3→9 is the biggest single jump remaining). N-PORT fund holdings require new EDGAR parser build. VC/PE tracking needs Form D network intelligence.

dimensions.spec: Integrate TradingView Lightweight Charts (Apache-licensed, zero cost). Add to Streamlit frontend via html() component. Support: candlestick, line, bar charts. Add technical overlay layers (SMA, EMA, BB, RSI subpane). Add volume histogram. Add vertical line markers for earnings, dividends, filings. Add symbol search. Add drawing tools (horizontal line, trend line). Target: adversarial 9.

Build ipo_intelligence.py: EFTS S-1 + S-1/A + 424B4 (final prospectus) pipeline. Add financial summary extraction (revenue growth, gross margin, burn rate from S-1 financials). Add lock-up expiry tracker (founder/VC share unlock dates). Add IPO roadshow calendar (Dealogic free data). Add post-IPO performance tracker (D1, D30, D90 vs index). Add comparable IPO multiples (recent IPOs in sector). Target: adversarial 9.

Add Polygon extended hours data (pre-market 4am-9:30am, post-market 4pm-8pm). Add pre-market gap scanner (stocks opening up/down >3% vs prior close). Add after-hours earnings reaction tracker (earnings release → after-hours move). Add extended hours volume alert. Requires Polygon Starter ($30/mo, combined with dims 1 and 3). Target: adversarial 9.

Build nport_parser.py: SEC N-PORT XBRL parser. Parse monthly portfolio holdings (vs quarterly 13F). Add fund holdings change vs prior month. Add ETF constituent comparison (N-PORT vs prospectus target). Add mutual fund style box detection (Morningstar 3x3 grid from holdings). Add fund universe search (who holds X, add to 13F context). Target: adversarial 9.

Build vc_intelligence.py: Form D portfolio company → Form ADV adviser crosswalk. Add fundraise velocity (how fast does this VC deploy capital). Add vintage year performance proxy (Form D raised → realized exits via M&A screener). Add LP identification from 13F filings (institutional investors in VC funds). Add co-investor network map (VCs that co-invest together). Target: adversarial 9.

waves.label: Score-0 New Builds: MSRB Muni, Job Postings, SDG Alignment
waves.rationale: Three zero-score dims that require entirely new modules. MSRB is free data waiting to be parsed. Job postings need scraping. SDG needs keyword taxonomy. Fewer agents — each is building from scratch.

dimensions.spec: Build msrb_client.py: MSRB EMMA API (free, no key) for muni trade data. Add muni yield curve by credit quality (AAA/AA/A general obligation). Add muni vs Treasury relative value (muni/treasury yield ratio by tenor). Add callable bond universe with yield-to-worst. Add muni screener (state, credit, yield, AMT status). Add muni credit monitor (EMMA disclosures + financial statement parser). Target: adversarial 9.

Build alt_data_signals.py: Indeed job posting trend (free RSS/API). Add Glassdoor rating trend (public scraping). Add SimilarWeb traffic trend via their public data embed. Add hiring surge detector (job postings up >50% MoM = growth signal). Add layoff detector (job postings down + 'separation' keywords in 8-K). Add HiringLab (Indeed Research) public dataset integration. Target: adversarial 9.

Build sdg_mapper.py: SASB materiality map (17 SDGs → GICS sector relevance weights). Add EDGAR 10-K SDG keyword scoring (100+ keywords per SDG from GRI/SASB vocabulary). Add company SDG profile (which of 17 SDGs does this company positively/negatively contribute to). Add SDG screener (find companies aligned with SDG 7 clean energy + SDG 13 climate action). Add SDG momentum tracking (SDG score trend over 3 years). Target: adversarial 9.

retry_waves.description: If adversarial scoring rejects any dim from waves 1-17, goal-loop-matrix auto-retries via --next-dims prioritization. Expected retry rate: 20-30% of dims (adversarial scorer is hostile). Budget 4-6 extra cycles.
